rules.description: Verify that every active StatVar covers historical 1990 benchmarks through at least 2021.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) <= 1990 AND CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2021 AND total_svs > 0

rules.description: Ensures that all statistical variables share a consistent maximum observation date.
